title: Recorded result of validating one checkout
description: The record of one validated checkout's run, stored at specs/023-extension-repo-profile/results/<slug>.json: the profile used, the measurements taken, every mismatch found and whether the 100% bar was met. It carries no timestamp and no absolute path, so two runs over the same code with equivalent profiles produce identical files and the result can be committed. The profile's hash is recorded but is not part of the determinism comparison: a fresh assistant's profile and the recorded one may be written differently and still express the same conventions.

repository.description: The slug, matching the expected-answer record's repository.

profile.description: Which profile was used, and what it could not read. Importing a profile with an empty problems list is the condition FR-022 calls a clean import.

sha256.description: Hash of the profile file's bytes as read. Identifies the profile without embedding a path.

path.description: Where in the profile, in dotted form with array indices, e.g. layers.rules[2].kinds.

message.description: One plain sentence: what was expected and what was found.

measurements.description: What the run counted. Sorted throughout, and free of walk order, so two equivalent runs agree byte for byte.

types.description: One [name, layer] pair per node, sorted.

links.description: One [view, viewModel] pair per view-to-view-model edge, sorted and de-duplicated.

conditions.description: The five conditions User Story 5 names. All must pass for a pass verdict.

layers.description: Every expected type sits in the layer its conventions give it, with no unexpected type.

links.description: Every view-to-view-model pair is found, with none missing and none invented.

findings.description: No finding comes from a convention mismatch, and none known true is missed.

import.description: The profile parses with zero problems.

invariants.description: The extension's own generic invariants pass against this checkout.

verdict.description: pass only when all five conditions pass. A checkout failing any one of them is recorded as failing, never as a partial success.

detail.description: One plain line, used by conditions that report a single fact: the self-test's summary line, or the number of problems the profile produced. Never a substitute for a mismatch list.

mismatches.description: Every failing item, one row each. Never reduced to a count.

name.description: The type the row is about: the type id for a type, the view for a link, the first named type for a finding.

expected.description: What the record says: a layer, a view model, no finding, no link, or not in the record.

actual.description: What the run produced, or null when it produced nothing.
